_comment: The voice every line is generated with (see tools/voice/). After changing anything here, run `npm run voice`: only the lines affected are made again. 'voice' is a Kokoro voice id. 'speed' is the pace he hears, where 1.0 is normal. 'engineSpeed' is the pace the speech engine itself is asked for; the recording is then slowed the rest of the way without changing its pitch. Keep engineSpeed at 1.0: asked to speak slowly, this engine adds a stray 'uh' to the start of short lines. 'sentencePause' is the gap in seconds between sentences in one line, 'bitrate' is the MP3 quality in kbps. 'say' fixes lines that sound wrong: the key is the exact text the game says, the value is what to hand the speech engine instead (respell a word, change the punctuation). The words on screen and in the code do not change.
